svg.title: KoFI: the known Subscriptions wall and surrounding current processes

text.tspan: Start with the Subscriptions wall from the previous seminars. The surrounding processes complete the picture of today's application.
Process frames show the source material, not proposed bounded contexts. Yellow labels show the current S5-start aggregates. Copy selected notes into your proposal below.
Local command + one event: attached. Several results: arrows. External result: command -> external system -> event. Automatic reaction: event -> policy -> command.
Domain events on this board are business facts; they do not imply a message bus or a particular delivery mechanism.
The familiar lifecycle, changes and delivery process. Same language; only currently implemented behaviour.
Changes (at any time, in parallel with deliveries)
Scheduled contents keep the agreed price. Changing a plan
updates only Scheduled deliveries; existing orders continue
Agreed items and prices; customer contact, address and saved card;
Today: charge saved card, reserve stock, add the paid order. A
rejected preparation leaves the delivery Scheduled.
Product offer and price; available stock; customer
Products: name, price, description, stock, active flag, roast,
Customer records and the saved card
Customers: contact, default address and VIP status
Saved card label; its token is used for all this
Orders: status, agreed prices, totals, address and
Configured login account and customer record are
Ownership structure and property names. These are aggregates, not bounded contexts.
AGGREGATE ROOT / ENTITY / VALUE OBJECT. Arrows show ownership and cardinality; external aggregates remain references by Id.
Repeated value-object notes are separate values belonging to their respective owners.
CustomerId, ProductId and OrderId refer outside this aggregate.
CustomerId and ProductId refer outside this aggregate.
Your proposal | Draw and name your bounded contexts here
Keep the source wall above intact. Copy representative command/event groups here. State purpose, owned data and decisions; show the information or actions needed from other contexts.
Choose your own number of contexts. Current aggregates can be grouped or reshaped. Retain one alternative to discuss.
Copy P beside a pivotal domain event and explain the change in the business story. Pivotal events are not automatically context borders.
